annotations.title: APK expiry of a Dutch vehicle (paid)

description: Use when the user asks when a Dutch car's APK (MOT) expires or whether it is still valid: expiry date, days left and a status band (expired, due within 30 or 90 days, ok), with insurance and open-recall flags. Cheap enough to run daily for a fleet. Input: Dutch licence plate. Source: RDW. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402, or 1 credit of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
